reason: Distinct from the escaping/attr-dynamic-escape/raw-interpolation family: when a single placeholder is the entire template body with no wrapping element, Marko emits the interpolated value completely unescaped (raw output for input {name:'X'} is literally '<X>X>', not '<b>X</b>'), unlike a placeholder inside any element, which Marko escapes correctly (see escaping/attr-dynamic-escape/raw-interpolation, all settled passes after semantic HTML comparison). Verified by direct render() call with a plain string. Filed as a Marko-side quirk specific to element-less templates, not something @markox/html should imitate.
